$ podkop device 2001:db8:3::60
# an IPv6 address in Fully Routed IPs of pc
exit 0

ℹ️ The rules for 2001:db8:3::60, in the order they are matched:
➖ Rule bank does not take it: only for 192.168.1.30
➖ Rule ads does not take it: only for 192.168.1.20
✅ Rule pc takes its connections that reach sing-box, those to the IPv6 subnets of the lists, not all its traffic (Fully Routed IPs, 2001:db8:3::60): through its servers
